h1: 7 Upright Carpet Cleaners Worth Owning, Ranked & Reviewed for 2026
metaTitle: Best Upright Carpet Cleaners: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 upright carpet cleaners from BISSELL and Hoover compared on pet formulas, tank design, heat, footprint and price, $100 to $500.
summary: The BISSELL ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is the upright carpet cleaner to buy if pets are the reason you are shopping, since it is built for deep cleaning with a pet formula. The BISSELL Big Green Professional is the heavy-duty alternative, the Hoover PowerScrub Deluxe is the strong mid-price scrubber, and the TurboClean models are the compact, cheaper way to handle regular upkeep.
intro: Rental-store habits mislead a lot of first-time buyers. People expect a home carpet cleaner to behave like the big machine they once dragged out of a supermarket, then wonder why a budget upright leaves carpet damp for a day. The truth is that how much water a machine leaves behind, how well it extracts, and how easy the tanks are to handle matter far more than a long feature list.

We ranked seven uprights from BISSELL and Hoover with that in mind. The review draws on the listings and spec sheets for pet-specific formulas, cleaning approach, footprint and price bucket. The listings give few numbers, so we avoid quoting tank sizes or pressures we cannot confirm, and we describe differences in terms of what each machine is designed to do.

products.name: BISSELL ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: The most complete deep cleaner in the group, with a pet formula and a premium build.
products.description:
The ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is the top of the BISSELL upright range here, and the listing flags a pet formula. The ProHeat line is known for heating the cleaning solution, which helps loosen set-in dirt and pet marks, and it sits in the $200 to $500 bracket.

It takes first place because it is aimed at the hardest jobs: pet stains, traffic lanes and carpets that have never been properly cleaned. The cost is bulk and price, since a full-size upright with larger tanks is heavier to push and store than the TurboClean models.

Buy it if you have pets and want one machine that handles deep cleaning. Skip it if your carpet only needs light refreshing a couple of times a year.
pros: Built for deep cleaning pet messes
ProHeat line warms the solution
Full-size tanks mean fewer refill trips
Pet formula included in the listing
products.idealFor: Pet owners who want true deep cleaning at home.
products.skipIf: You only touch up small areas now and then.

products.name: BISSELL Big Green Professional Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: A pro-style machine for large, heavily soiled carpets, with a pet formula on the listing.
products.description:
Big Green is BISSELL's professional-style upright, priced in the $200 to $500 range, and the listing mentions a pet formula. It is the machine to look at when the carpet is large and filthy rather than lightly worn.

It places second because it is built like a work tool, but it lacks the heating emphasis of the ProHeat. Compared with the compact TurboClean machines, it is larger and demands more storage room, and heavy machines take more effort to steer around furniture.

Choose it for multi-room carpeting, busy households or rental properties. If your carpet is small or you want a lighter machine, pick one of the TurboClean models.
pros: Professional-style build for heavy soil
Handles large carpeted areas well
Pet formula mentioned in the listing
Trusted BISSELL name with parts access
cons: Harder to steer than compact models
products.idealFor: Large homes and rental properties with heavy traffic.
products.skipIf: You live in a small space with minimal carpet.

products.name: Hoover PowerScrub Deluxe Carpet Cleaner Machine
products.verdict: A scrub-focused Hoover with a pet formula, priced well below the BISSELL flagships.
products.description:
The PowerScrub Deluxe is a Hoover upright that lists a pet formula and falls in the $100 to $200 bucket. The name points to its approach, which relies on agitating scrub brushes to work solution into the pile.

It ranks third because it delivers much of the deep-cleaning idea at half the cost of the ProHeat, though without heating. It also offers a different brand's parts network, which some owners prefer to BISSELL's. The tradeoff is that the listing offers few specifics, so tank size and hose accessories are worth checking before purchase.

Buy it if you want a capable mid-priced machine for regular cleaning. Pet households with severe staining may prefer the ProHeat.
pros: Scrub-brush action works solution into carpet
Pet formula listed with the machine
Much cheaper than the flagship BISSELLs
Alternative brand with its own parts
cons: No heating emphasis in the listing
products.idealFor: Households that want strong cleaning on a mid budget.
products.skipIf: You need heated cleaning for old pet stains.

products.name: BISSELL Revolution HydroSteam Pet Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: A pet-focused BISSELL with a steam feature, positioned as a backup if the leaders do not fit.
products.description:
The Revolution HydroSteam Pet is a BISSELL upright that the listing associates with steam, and it sits in the $200 to $500 bracket. The pet branding puts it in the same audience as the ProHeat.

It ranks fourth because it costs the same as the top two without the clear lead over them. A steam or heated element may help with grime and odors, but the listing offers no technical detail, so the benefit is hard to judge from the page alone.

It makes sense if you like the heated approach and the style appeals, or if the ProHeat is out of stock. Otherwise, the Hoover is better value and the ProHeat is stronger.
pros: Steam feature helps with stubborn grime
Pet branding fits shedding households
BISSELL brand with wide parts support
Full upright reach for large rooms
cons: Premium price without a clear edge
products.idealFor: Pet owners who specifically want a steam-assisted cleaner.
products.skipIf: You want proven results for the price.

products.name: BISSELL TurboClean PET
products.verdict: A compact upright for pet owners, with more features than the base TurboClean.
products.description:
The TurboClean PET is a compact BISSELL upright for the $100 to $200 range. The listing points to a fuller feature set than the other TurboClean models and suggests it for buyers willing to pay more.

It ranks fifth because compact uprights suit regular upkeep rather than the toughest stains. They are lighter to push and easier to store than the ProHeat or Big Green, which counts for a lot in apartments. The tradeoff is smaller capacity, so large rooms need more refill trips.

Buy it for moderate pet mess and apartment-sized carpets. If you have heavy staining or wide carpeted areas, step up to the ProHeat.
pros: Compact body is easier to store
Pet-focused feature set for the price
Lighter to push than full-size rivals
Suits apartments and small homes
cons: Less suited to old, set-in stains
products.idealFor: Apartment dwellers with moderate pet mess.
products.skipIf: You face heavy staining or wide carpets.

products.name: BISSELL TurboClean Pet XL Upright Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: The listing's lowest-cost pick, aimed at pet owners who want to spend as little as possible.
products.description:
The TurboClean Pet XL is an upright BISSELL in the $100 to $200 range. The listing highlights it as the lowest cost option in its comparison, and the name hints at a larger scale than the standard TurboClean.

It lands sixth since cost is its main appeal, and the listing offers little else. Compared with the TurboClean PET above, it saves money but loses the fuller feature set. It does stay in the BISSELL ecosystem, so replacement formulas and brushes are easy to find.

Choose it if budget is the deciding factor and your cleaning needs are modest. For deep cleaning, look higher up this list.
pros: Lowest cost in the group per listing
Pet-oriented model in a familiar line
BISSELL formulas are easy to buy
Upright design covers rooms quickly
cons: Fewer features than the TurboClean PET
products.idealFor: Budget shoppers with light to moderate pet mess.
products.skipIf: You want deep cleaning or heated cleaning.

products.name: BISSELL TurboClean Upright Carpet Cleaner
products.verdict: The base TurboClean, chosen for its smaller footprint and everyday upkeep role.
products.description:
The base TurboClean is an upright BISSELL in the $100 to $200 range, and the listing recommends it for limited space. It has no pet branding in the title, so it is a general-purpose option.

It ranks last because the pet versions offer more for similar money, but it makes sense when storage is tight and pets are not part of the picture. A smaller upright slides into a closet that a full-size machine never would.

Pick it for a small flat or a household without pets. Anyone who shares a home with animals should choose a pet model instead.

methodology.title: Cleaning approach
methodology.description: We read each listing for heating, steam and scrubbing cues, favoring designs that match the job of lifting dirt and stains from carpet.

methodology.title: Pet suitability
methodology.description: Pet formulas and pet-specific models earned credit where the listing names them, since pet stains are the top reason to buy.

methodology.title: Size and handling
methodology.description: Footprint and likely weight were compared, because a machine that is hard to push or store gets used less.

methodology.title: Brand and parts support
methodology.description: Established makers with accessible formulas, brushes and service scored higher, as listings rarely publish warranty detail.

methodology.title: Value in each price bucket
methodology.description: Each upright was judged against its bracket, rewarding machines that give more capability for the money.

whatMatters.detail: Heated solution helps loosen oils and old pet marks, while agitating brushes lift dirt out of the pile. Machines vary in which approach they emphasise. Check the listing for words such as heat, steam or scrub, and match them to the type of soil you actually have.

A carpet left saturated can take a day to dry and may develop odors. Good extraction pulls most of the water back into the dirty tank, so the carpet feels only damp. Check owner feedback for drying time rather than trusting the product page, and ventilate the room afterward.

Separate clean and dirty tanks are the standard, and bigger ones mean fewer trips to the sink. Tanks that are easy to lift, rinse and refit matter more than headline capacity. Read the listing for tank handles and check whether the dirty tank has a wide opening for rinsing.

Most manufacturers sell their own cleaning solutions, and using the wrong one can leave residue or void warranty terms. Pet formulas target odors and organic stains. Confirm which formula the machine ships with and what the maker recommends.

Uprights are bulky when filled, and a full tank adds a lot of weight. Compact models like the TurboClean fit a closet, while Big Green and ProHeat need a dedicated corner. Measure your storage space and consider how often you will lift the machine upstairs.

howToChoose.intro: Decide how dirty your carpet really is, since heavy soil justifies a heavier machine.

cards.label: Full-size
cards.text: Larger tanks, more power and better for wide, soiled carpets, but heavy and bulky. The ProHeat and Big Green lead this group.

cards.label: Compact
cards.text: Lighter, easier to store and quicker to set up, with smaller capacity. The TurboClean models are the picks.

howToChoose.note: Go full-size only if you clean large areas or tough stains.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A pet formula, a way to apply heat or agitation, and a dirty tank that is easy to rinse. Pet urine needs thorough extraction, not just surface cleaning.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is the strongest, and the TurboClean PET is the compact budget pick.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You have pets, wide carpets or older stains. The ProHeat or Big Green pays back over time against rental costs.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You clean a small room once or twice a year. A TurboClean or the Hoover is enough.

faq.q: Can I use any cleaning solution in these machines?
faq.a: Check the manual first. BISSELL and Hoover each sell formulas designed for their machines, and using a high-sudsing or unapproved product can leave residue or foam. A pet formula is the right choice for urine and odors.

faq.q: What mistake do people make with upright carpet cleaners?
faq.a: Using too much water and not enough passes. Overwetting soaks the padding and prolongs drying, while slow, overlapping passes with a final dry pass give better results than flooding the carpet.

faq.q: Is an upright worth it over renting a machine?
faq.a: If you clean more than once or twice a year, yes. Owning avoids rental timing and costs, and you can treat spills straight away. A single cleaning a year may still be cheaper to rent.

faq.q: How do I set one up?
faq.a: Fill the clean tank with water and the recommended formula, check the hose and nozzle are seated, and vacuum the carpet first. A pre-vacuum removes loose hair and grit so the machine only has to deal with embedded soil.

faq.q: How should I maintain it after use?
faq.a: Empty and rinse both tanks, wipe the brush area and let all parts dry before storing. Damp tanks left sealed can grow mould and smell, so air dry them uncapped.

faq.q: Will it work on stairs or upholstery?
faq.a: Only with a hose attachment, and only if your model supports one. Check whether the machine includes a hose and tool before buying for stairs, as some compact models rely on a dedicated hand tool.

finalTake: For pet owners and tough stains, the BISSELL ProHeat 2X Revolution Pet Pro Plus is the upright carpet cleaner to buy. The Big Green suits large or rented spaces, the Hoover PowerScrub Deluxe gives strong value in the middle, and the TurboClean models handle routine upkeep in small homes. Match the machine to how dirty and how big your carpet is, and do not pay for heat you will not use.
